design_note: Curves for the investor's targets past the authored list in content/investor/targets.json, and the pressure hooks the economy reads per Investor Level. Generated targets start from the last authored non-alternate target and grow by `token_growth` per level; `quality_step` is added to quality_min per level (capped at `quality_cap`); `deadline_rounds` is the deadline of every generated target. `rent_mult_by_level` and `reward_mult_by_level` are indexed by level - 1 (the last entry repeats) and ship at 1.0 so balance is unchanged until they are tuned.
